headline: V26-3747: host the delivery viewer anywhere, not only on Cloudflare

V26-3748.title: Write the protocol spec and a black-box conformance suite

criteria.text: Before any refactor, the suite's fast and slow tiers pass against today's Worker.
Every planted-failure server fails the suite, naming the scenario that server is expected to trip. A planted server that fails to start is a failed proof.
A change that touches only the spec or the suite triggers the hosted workflow and selects the hosted checks.
tests.test_own_deliveries, including test_integration_recipe_carries_only_named_checks_and_refuses_collisions, stays green.

V26-3749.title: Split the service into a neutral core and a Cloudflare adapter

criteria.text: Every existing service test passes, and both conformance tiers pass against the Worker.
The storage contract suite passes against the Durable Object store.
Each planted-failure server, now the core with one rule removed, still fails the suite, naming its expected scenario.

V26-3750.title: Ship a portable Node server and container

criteria.text: The storage contract suite, both conformance tiers and the Chromium suite pass against the portable server.

The real publisher works against it. The corpus publisher's Transport, through its existing loopback seam, does acquire, two commits, confirm, status, an exact retry and a server restart. The page then renders the last committed cut in Chromium.
Crash recovery: after a crash or an injected fault between the blob write and the transaction, the last committed view and pointer survive, and a retry commits.
Gate: first confirm that node:sqlite needs no flag on ^22.22.2 || >=24.15.0. If it does, stop and return the decision to the operator.

V26-3751.title: Run conformance for both adapters as checks

criteria.text: Both new checks pass locally, and each is selected by changes to the hosted trigger paths.
CI records the slow tier for both servers and the container run.
Locally, Docker is an optional sensor, reported as unavailable where it is missing.
tests.test_own_deliveries is green.

V26-3752.title: Carry a verified service bundle in each release

criteria.text: Two cuts give identical bytes, one of them on a copy of the tree with every mtime and one mode bit changed.
The bundle contains hosted/protocol/hosted-delivery-api-1.md and the conformance entry point, and its roots equal the hosted workflow's trigger paths minus the workflow file.
Refusals, each with a named code:
a missing root;
a bundle corrupted between write and recheck.
The dry-run publish lists both files, and the notes list the digest.
Each phrase that tests pin in these files and that moves is re-derived in the same change.
scripts/update-provenance.py --check and scripts/validate-registry.py pass.
The full local suite passes on macOS with Python 3.11, inside its budget.

finish.label: The stories
finish.text: V26-3748, V26-3749, V26-3750, V26-3751, V26-3752 and V26-3753 land on integrate/portable-hosted-service through its merge queue

finish.label: Service CI
finish.text: A service CI run at the final integration commit records the conformance slow tier for both servers and the container run, dispatched with workflow_dispatch when the push did not run it

finish.label: Local suite
finish.text: The full local suite passes on macOS with Python 3.11 at the integration head, with --workers 4 --budget tests/suite-budget.json

finish.label: Into main
finish.text: The integration base is reviewed for main, as the orchestrate-work guide's integration review says, and merged into main
